known_limitations: Both judges conflate nationality and legal citizenship in some calibration cases.
Explicit approximation and missing temporal roles are not handled consistently with strict equivalence.
Binary correctness and completeness may be conflated; a weaker assertion can still be supported.
Negation expressed in both predicate wording and polarity has no fully validated interpretation.
Agreement between judges is not accuracy, and Sonnet is not human ground truth.
Calibration has been discussed, but no independent human reference labels or judge error rate have been established.
status: closed with known limitations; not validated ground truth
